# Boaz the Redeemer (Ruth 2:12)

## Emotional Focus
God provides a redeemer who takes care of us.

## Key KJV
“The LORD recompense thy work, and a full reward be given thee of the LORD God of Israel.” (Ruth 2:12)

## Gentle Retelling (3–8)
Boaz was kind to Ruth and became her redeemer. He took care of her and Naomi and made them part of his family.
